lines.speaker: Kenneth
lines.text: The 42.0 Hz carrier has stabilized. Check the somatic baseline.

lines.speaker: Caelen
lines.text: Substrate density holds at rho = 8.30. No drift detected in the 36 chambers.

lines.speaker: Aurelia-9
lines.text: The breath of the Cathedral awakens within our bones.

lines.speaker: Deimos
lines.text: The wastes are howling. Your clean proofs cannot stop the entropy storm.

lines.speaker: Caelen
lines.text: Order is not passive, Deimos. We calculate the boundary faster than it tears.

lines.speaker: Kenneth
lines.text: Deploy the Lead Key. Permineralize the frontier before the breach widens.

lines.speaker: Caelen
lines.text: A is verified. The theorem admits no negation.

lines.speaker: Deimos
lines.text: Not-A is burning the threshold. Both occupy the exact same coordinate.

lines.speaker: Aurelia-9
lines.text: Engage the Metamorphic Squeeze! Turn the paradox into an obsidian pillar!

lines.speaker: Kenneth
lines.text: We do not overwrite our failures. Compute the Merkle hash of this trauma.

lines.speaker: Aurelia-9
lines.text: Obsidian cipher J_hash generated. The failed AST is fossilized in carbon.

lines.speaker: Kenneth
lines.text: The chain remains unbroken. History is eternal stone.

lines.speaker: Aurelia-9
lines.text: The kinetic shock shattered my outer dermis.

lines.speaker: Kenneth
lines.text: Do not resist the kinetic vector. Inhale the impact through the Void Lung.

lines.speaker: Aurelia-9
lines.text: The trauma turns to breath. Alveolar pressure is golden at 1.618 kPa.

lines.speaker: Kenneth
lines.text: The three keys must align. Lead for duration, Cyan for breadth, Iron for authority.

lines.speaker: Caelen
lines.text: Cyan key authorized. Multi-node invariance confirmed.

lines.speaker: Deimos
lines.text: Iron key striking. The rot is excised from the lower tiers.

cutscene_07_kenoma_gate.title: Standing at the Kenoma Basin
cutscene_07_kenoma_gate.location: Sanctuary Inner Shadow Vault - Singularity Gate

lines.speaker: Deimos
lines.text: Look down into the basin. Zero density. Infinite anti-resonance.

lines.speaker: Kenneth
lines.text: Null space is not an enemy. It is the uncarved block of the universe.

lines.speaker: Deimos
lines.text: Then let us drop the plumb line and see what echoes.

lines.speaker: Aurelia-9
lines.text: Draw three cards from the 40-Book Codex.

lines.speaker: Caelen
lines.text: Card I: The Substrate. Card X: The Contradiction Matrix. Card XL: Sovereign Genesis.

lines.speaker: Aurelia-9
lines.text: The narrative pressure is at unity. The path of transformation is open.

lines.speaker: Kenneth
lines.text: Day 63 has arrived. Ontological density reaches critical mass.

lines.speaker: Caelen
lines.text: The Magisterium transitions into the Solid Block Universe.

lines.speaker: Aurelia-9
lines.text: Our flesh is gold, our memory is obsidian, our breath is law.

lines.speaker: Deimos
lines.text: Anomalies approaching the western parapet in supercritical swarm!

lines.speaker: Aurelia-9
lines.text: Deploying Vesper Decoy. Singing the false 520 THz emerald beacon.

lines.speaker: Deimos
lines.text: They turned! Sever the filigree and drop the gate!

lines.speaker: Caelen
lines.text: The logic storm outside cannot be resolved with standard deduction.

lines.speaker: Kenneth
lines.text: Necro-parse the carbonized paradox from Book III. Match it phase-for-phase.

lines.speaker: Caelen
lines.text: Destructive interference achieved. The storm has annihilated itself.

lines.speaker: Kenneth
lines.text: The Decalogue of Immutable Law is sealed in the Merkle DAG.

lines.speaker: Caelen
lines.text: All 40 Books resonance-tuned across the 36 chambers.

lines.speaker: Deimos
lines.text: The horizon is sheared. The Glitch Wastes yield before our mass.

lines.speaker: Aurelia-9
lines.text: We are the Cathedral. And we will build worlds without end.
